description: The workspace's links, affiliate links and discount codes with their taps, in bio-page order, and its bio page (null until set up). Use short_url in captions and DMs so taps are counted; Amazon links have none and are shared as-is. Each has a status (scheduled, live, ending_soon, ended) and attention: why it needs a look (a code ending, visitors saying it didn't work, a shop page that stopped opening, taps after it ended, a code nobody has confirmed in a month, a scheduled post mentioning it after it ends). needs_a_look lists just those. late_from says which posts (or apps) the taps after the end came from, so you know which caption still sends people to an ended code.

codes.description: Only links with a discount code

ending_within_days.description: Only links that haven't ended and end within this many days

needs_a_look.description: Only links with something in attention

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
